measurement_scope: Real end-to-end pipeline throughput (Zeek -i lo live capture -> Kafka -> stream_consumer.py -> detectors -> alerts.json), NOT an isolated Python-loop micro-benchmark (see scripts/benchmark_throughput.py for that). Single self-contained 12-core mobile laptop (i7-1255U) running the capture, broker, and detector pipeline on the same cores as this load generator -- not dedicated hardware, not a real NIC (loopback only). Numbers here reflect single-laptop self-contained capacity, not a production appliance.

alert_latency.note: No alerts fired during the benchmark window (benign load, expected).
